title: 'The Boys of Dungeon Lane': Paul McCartney releases 18th solo album
summary: Paul McCartney has had an illustrious six decade career – in the 60s with The Beatles, the 70s with his rock band Wings, and with a seemingly endless stream of solo albums. Now the 83-year- old is back with his 18th LP – the first in 6 years – and one that has been described by Rolling Stones as 'a late-career Masterpiece'.
